estimates.assumptions: 2 medium sweet potatoes (total ~400g raw, edible portion); standard nutritional values for sweet potato.
1 medium apple (~180g with core removed, as described); standard values for raw apple with skin.
2 cloves garlic (~6g total, peeled and chopped); standard garlic nutrition.
1 lemon (~100g whole); juice used for seasoning, modest contribution from squeezes only.
2 boneless pork chops (~200g raw total edible portion, typical 4-5oz each); pan-seared without added fat in estimate.
1 medium zucchini (~200g raw, trimmed and sliced); standard raw zucchini values.
1 unit chicken stock concentrate (~10-15g, typical packet/jar equivalent for 1 cup stock); modest values for concentrate.
1 tbsp vegetable oil (14g); all oil assumed used in roasting and pan (drizzles + pan heat).
1.5 tsp sugar (~6g); standard granulated sugar nutrition.
2 tbsp butter (28g total); fully used as stated in sauce step.
